comparison.objective: Fit lids to cups on a moving belt; no detailed rubric or spec version is available.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed lid alignment and placement, not loosening a setscrew, rotating a retained collar, and retightening it.
comparison.success_condition: Cups are lidded in motion versus a damper survives two qualifying physical cycles at a stable setting.
comparison.reason: Insertion/placement on a conveyor is meaningfully different from iterative mechanical commissioning.
